prompt_meta.title: GA E2E Validation: Android + iOS simulators + Web E2E + RC Checklist (all core flows end-to-end) + GitHub push

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0015 report is shared with ChatGPT

step_objectives.goal: Run true end-to-end validation across Mobile (Android + iOS simulators) and Web for all GA features, with automated E2E tests, evidence capture, and a clear RC checklist.
outcomes: Android emulator runs app end-to-end against local API/infra
iOS Simulator runs app end-to-end (or BLOCKED with exact limitation)
Web passes E2E tests against local API/infra
All critical journeys verified and documented
Push flows verified: if provider is mock, verify NotificationService 'send attempted' logs + tap-to-open deep link behavior
Evidence captured and referenced (avoid committing huge binaries)
RC checklist created with pass/fail status per journey
Fixes applied for any failures and pushed to GitHub main with CI green
constraints: No new product features; only bug fixes, test harness, tooling and E2E coverage.
Owner does not execute local commands manually.
No secrets committed; use env + documented setup.
If simulator tooling needs UI approvals (Xcode license, Android Studio, etc.), attempt automation first, then report limitation clearly.
definition_of_done: Local infra comes up automatically (docker compose) and API/Web/Mobile run against it
Automated E2E suite exists for Web and Mobile (Android required; iOS if feasible)
E2E covers minimum critical journeys list (below)
Evidence assets stored under reports/assets/STEP-0015/ and referenced in report
ops/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST.md complete (no placeholders) with all passes or clearly documented blockers
pnpm -r integrity/lint/test/build pass AND E2E commands pass
All changes committed and pushed to GitHub main

critical_journeys_minimum_coverage: Auth: signup -> login -> logout -> session persists -> protected screens gated
Onboarding: profile + preferred sports -> gating removed -> reaches dashboard
Games approval: create (approval) -> request -> host approve/deny -> notifications generated -> join state changes
Private invite: create private -> generate token -> redeem -> join flow works
Venues: list/search -> detail -> create game with venue -> game detail shows venue
Clubs: create (web) -> discover -> request join -> approve -> create club-hosted game -> linkage verified
Chat: approved participants can chat -> polling updates -> blocked user messages hidden -> report created
Safety: block user -> verify chat visibility changes -> report persists
Ratings/Reputation: after completed game -> rate -> edit within window -> profile shows aggregation/badges
Notifications: in-app list -> tap -> navigates correctly
Deep links: unauth -> login -> redirect; onboarding-needed -> onboarding -> redirect; ready -> direct open

Push: If provider is mock/logging, verify server 'send attempted' logs are emitted for at least 2 events (chat + game approval) and that payload mapping matches docs; if real push is available, verify 1 real delivery + tap-to-open.

tasks.name: Bring up infra and run apps end-to-end locally
tasks.objective: Ensure docker compose infra is up and API/Web/Mobile run against it.
acceptance: All services reachable and smoke flows work

tasks.name: Android emulator + app run proof
tasks.objective: Launch Android emulator, run the app, capture evidence screenshots.

tasks.name: iOS Simulator + app run proof (if possible)
tasks.objective: Launch iOS Simulator, run the app, capture evidence screenshots.
constraints: If blocked, report exact limitation and remediation without delegating to owner
acceptance: iOS run verified OR BLOCKED with precise evidence

tasks.name: Implement Web E2E suite
tasks.objective: Add Web E2E tests for critical journeys.
acceptance: Web E2E passes and is runnable via root scripts

tasks.name: Implement Mobile E2E suite
tasks.objective: Add Mobile E2E tests runnable on Android; iOS if feasible.
constraints: IDE chooses tooling; must be reliable in CI/dev
acceptance: Mobile E2E passes on Android at minimum

tasks.name: Verify push/notification E2E behavior
tasks.objective: Validate notification generation, navigation, deep links; if push provider is mock/logging, assert send-attempt logs and payload mapping.
constraints: No secrets; do not require real push delivery
acceptance: Evidence includes logs + navigation proof + checklist entries

tasks.name: RC checklist + docs + evidence
tasks.objective: Write docs/checklist and store evidence assets.
constraints: No placeholders; do not commit huge binaries
acceptance: Docs complete and referenced in report

tasks.name: Quality gates + GitHub push
tasks.objective: Run gates including E2E; fix failures; commit and push to main.
acceptance: Commit hash + push evidence in report

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Add E2E coverage (web + mobile), run Android emulator and iOS simulator if feasible, capture evidence, verify push flows (mock logs are acceptable), fix any E2E-found bugs, keep CI green, commit and push to GitHub main, update ops/manifest.json, and write a complete reports/STEP-0015.report.json with no placeholders.
